androidEntry.behavior: Open ContractCalculatorActivity from the active contract trade toolbar and pass partnerTradeId
androidEntry.visibility: Trade page only; FuturesTradeContainerFragment hides calculator action on the K-line page

tabs.label: 强平价格
inputs: 增加保证金或可用保证金

sharedBehavior.contractSelector: Uses the calculator currency list and refreshes faceValue, maker/taker fees and trade id
sharedBehavior.leverageRange: Android clamps to 1..125 and derives max position from leverage tiers
sharedBehavior.maxPosition: Choose the eligible tier with the smallest maxLever >= requested leverage, then enableNum * faceValue rounded to 4 decimals
sharedBehavior.disclaimer: 计算结果仅供参考；强平页 additionally states calculations are not based on real market data

dataDependencies: GET /contract/leverSetting/list with exact partnerTradeId and positionType=BY or FULL
implementationGate: Do not expose a calculator route or toolbar entry until all three tabs, current-contract identity, live metadata, tier loading/failure states and deterministic formula tests are present. A two-tab or shell-only calculator would be a product regression against the Android reference.
